salubrious.definition: s. favorable to health of mind or body
salubrious.translation:
a. 有益健康的, 健康的
[医] 增进健康的, 适于卫生的

salubriously.translation: adv. （空气、气候等）有益健康地(salubrious的变形)

salubriousness.definition: n. the quality of being salubrious and invigorating
salubriousness.translation: n. salubrious（健康的, 强健的；有益健康的）的变形

salubrity.definition: n. the quality of being salubrious and invigorating
salubrity.translation:
n. 有益健康, 强身
[医] 增进健康, 适于卫生

salue.translation: [地名] [印度尼西亚] 萨卢埃

saluki.definition: n. old breed of tall swift keen-eyed hunting dogs resembling greyhounds; from Egypt and southwestern Asia

salukis.translation: n. 萨卢基狗（一种体细长而高大，皮毛光滑的猎犬）( saluki的名词复数 )

salus.translation: n. [罗神]萨卢斯(司健康、幸福和兴盛的女神)

salus' arch.translation: [医] 萨路斯氏弧(视网膜静脉经过动脉时所形成的弧,见于动脉硬化)

salutary.definition: s tending to promote physical well-being; beneficial to health
salutary.translation:
a. 有益的, 有用的, 有益健康的
[医] 适于健康的

salutation.definition: n. word of greeting used to begin a letter
salutation.translation: n. 招呼, 寒喧, 问候

salutations.definition:
n. an act of honor or courteous recognition
n. (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)
n. word of greeting used to begin a letter
salutations.translation: n. 招呼( salutation的复数形式 ); 致意; 致敬; 信函中的称呼语

salutatorian.definition: n. a graduating student with the second highest academic rank; may deliver the opening address at graduation exercises
salutatorian.translation: n. (毕业典礼时)致词的学生

salutatory.definition: n an opening or welcoming statement (especially one delivered at graduation exercises)
salutatory.translation:
n. (毕业典礼的)开幕词, 祝词
a. 致意的, 表示欢迎的

salute.definition:
n. an act of honor or courteous recognition
n. a formal military gesture of respect
n. an act of greeting with friendly words and gestures like bowing or lifting the hat
v. greet in a friendly way
salute.translation:
vi. 行礼, 致意, 问候, 放礼炮
vt. 向...致意, 迎接, 赞扬
n. 招呼, 敬礼, 礼炮

saluted.translation: v. 欢迎, 致敬( salute的过去式和过去分词 ); 赞扬, 赞颂

saluter.translation: n. 致敬, 欢迎；敬礼 (salute的变形)

salutes.definition:
n an act of honor or courteous recognition
n a formal military gesture of respect
n an act of greeting with friendly words and gestures like bowing or lifting the hat
v propose a toast to
v greet in a friendly way
v express commendation of
v become noticeable
v honor with a military ceremony, as when honoring dead soldiers
v recognize with a gesture prescribed by a military regulation; assume a prescribed position
salutes.translation:
n. 致敬, 欢迎, 敬礼( salute的名词复数 )
v. 欢迎, 致敬( salute的第三人称单数 ); 赞扬, 赞颂

salutiferous.definition:
a. Bringing health; healthy; salutary; beneficial; as,
   salutiferous air.

saluting.definition:
v propose a toast to
v greet in a friendly way
v express commendation of
v become noticeable
v honor with a military ceremony, as when honoring dead soldiers
v recognize with a gesture prescribed by a military regulation; assume a prescribed position
saluting.translation: v. 欢迎, 致敬( salute的现在分词 ); 赞扬, 赞颂

saluts.translation: (salut 的复数) <法>int.祝你健康,干杯[字面意义：health]
